explication: AList is a multi-storage file-listing and sharing service. A user request enters through HTTP/API routes, reaches filesystem or management handlers, then operates on mounted storage drivers; results are delivered as listings, previews, downloads, or mutations. The repository also exposes WebDAV, S3, FTP/SFTP, and MCP interfaces, plus search and offline-download capabilities. Edges reflect sampled source references and explicit README capabilities; some feature-level wiring is documented but not sampled.
